1: Plan your EuroVelo 1 adventure from Norway to Spain. Interactive map, free GPX files, 11,150km of coastal cycling.
2: Explore EuroVelo 2 – Capitals Route as you cycle between Europe's great capitals. Discover route maps, GPX downloads, accommodation and travel inspiration.
3: Cycle on EuroVelo 3 – Pilgrims Route. Follow historic pilgrimage paths across Western Europe on La Scandibérique and Camino de Santiago. Route maps, GPX downloads, stages.
4: Plan your cycling trip on EuroVelo 4 – Central Europe Route. 5,000 km through France and Germany on La Vélomaritime or Mainradweg. Maps, GPX tracks, stages, accommodation.
5: Explore EuroVelo 5 – Via Romea (Francigena) by bicycle. Cycle from England to Italy through Flanders, Alsace and Milan. Maps, GPX downloads, stages, accommodation and travel inspiration.
6: Cycle 4,500 km on EuroVelo 6 – Atlantic–Black Sea along Europe's most iconic long-distance cycle routes. Discover Loire, Passau, Vienna, Budapest, Belgrade by bicycle. Maps, GPX tracks, stages and accommodation information.
7: Explore EuroVelo 7 – Sun Route by bicycle, from Norway to the Mediterranean via Copenhagen, Berlin, Prague and Lake Garda, on the Kattegattleden, Elberadweg, Innradweg and Alpe Adria. Route maps, GPX downloads.
8: Cycle 7,450 km from Cadiz to Cyprus on EuroVelo 8. Interactive map, GPX downloads, 83-page handbook. Spain, France, Italy, Croatia, Greece & more.
9: Plan your cycling trip on EuroVelo 9 – Baltic–Adriatic crossing six countries from Gdańsk on the Baltic to Pula on the Adriatic. Interactive map, GPX downloads and accommodation.
10: EuroVelo 10 Baltic Sea Cycle Route: 9,100 km through 9 countries. Interactive map, free GPX downloads, stage overview & bookable cycling tours.
11: Discover EuroVelo 11 – East Europe Route, 7,000 km from Norway to Greece.  Helsinki, Vilnius, Warsaw, Belgrade, Skopje and Athens by bicycle. Route maps, GPX downloads and accommodation.
12: Cycle around the North Sea with EuroVelo 12 – North Sea Cycle Route. Follow a circuit with dramatic coastlines along Scotland, England, Netherlands, Germany, Denmark, Sweden and Norway via Kattegattleden and Hamburg. Maps, GPX downloads.
13: Discover Europe's historic former border on EuroVelo 13 – Iron Curtain Trail for unique cycling experiences acoss 10,000 km through 20 countries, from the Barents Sea to the Black Sea. Maps, GPX downloads, stage information.
14: Explore EuroVelo 14 – Waters of Central Europe by cycling along the rivers, spas and lakes of Austria and Hungary, from the Alps to Lake Balaton, Budapest and Tisza on  Tauernradweg, Ennsradweg and Murradweg. Maps, GPX tracks, and accommodation.
15: Plan your Rhine cycling adventure from the Swiss Alps to the North Sea. Free GPX download, interactive map, stage guides & accommodation along EV15.
17: Follow the Rhône river from the Alps to the Mediterranean on EuroVelo 17 – Rhone Cycle Route. Cycle from Lake Geneva to Sète and the Camargue, on Via Rhôna. Interactive maps, GPX downloads, and travel inspiration.
19: Explore the Meuse Cycle Route (EuroVelo 19) from France to the Netherlands. Interactive map, GPX downloads, stage guide & accommodation for your cycling adventure.
